en.t: In the wake of the murder of Julius Caesar, his nephew and heir, Octavian, uses the threat of military force to compel the Roman Senate to elect him Consul
en.s: Gaius Julius Caesar (12 or 13 July 100 BC – 15 March 44 BC) was a Roman general, statesman, and author who was the dictator of the Roman Republic almost continuously from 49 BC until his assassination in 44 BC. A member of the First Triumvirate, he led the Roman armies through the Gallic Wars and defeated his political rival Pompey in Caesar's civil war.

zh.t: 尤利乌斯·恺撒遇刺后，其侄子兼继承人屋大维以军事力量相威胁，迫使罗马元老院选举他为执政官
zh.s: 盖乌斯·尤利乌斯·恺撒（公元前100年7月12日或13日—公元前44年3月15日）是罗马将军、政治家和作家，公元前49年至公元前44年遇刺期间几乎一直担任罗马共和国独裁官。他是第一三头同盟成员，曾率领罗马军队征战高卢，并在恺撒内战中击败政敌庞培。

en.s: The Battle of al-Mada'in was fought near al-Mada'in in central Iraq between the armies of the Hamdanids and the Baridis, for control over Baghdad, the capital and seat of the Abbasid Caliphate, that was around 22 kilometres (14 mi) away and then under control of the Hamdanids. In a fiercely contested battle over four days (16–19 August 942) that cost both sides many casualties, the Hamdanid army prevailed.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 马达因战役发生在伊拉克中部马达因附近，参战双方是哈姆丹王朝和巴里迪家族的军队，争夺约22公里（14英里）外的巴格达。当时，巴格达是阿拔斯哈里发国的首都和王朝所在地，由哈姆丹王朝控制。战斗于942年8月16日至19日持续四天，双方伤亡惨重，最终哈姆丹军获胜。

en.t: Abu Yazid, a Kharijite rebel leader, is defeated and killed in the Hodna Mountains in modern-day Algeria by Fatimid forces
en.s: Abū Yazīd Makhlad ibn Kaydād (Arabic: أبو يزيد مخلد بن كيداد;‎ c. 873 – 19 August 947), was a member of the Ibadi sect. He opposed the Ismaili Shia rule of the Fatimids in North Africa and sought to restore Ibadi dominance in the region.

zh.t: 哈瓦利吉派叛军首领阿布·亚齐德在今阿尔及利亚的霍德纳山脉被法蒂玛军队击败并杀死
zh.s: 阿布·亚齐德·马克拉德·伊本·凯达德（阿拉伯语：أبو يزيد مخلد بن كيداد；约873年—947年8月19日）是伊巴德派成员。他反对法蒂玛王朝在北非的伊斯玛仪派什叶派统治，并试图恢复伊巴德派在该地区的主导地位。

en.s: The Battle of Křeč occurred on 19 August 1435 and was the last real battle of the Hussite Wars. A year earlier, the Battle of Lipany brought an end to most Radical Hussite power in Bohemia, but some groups had still continued fighting. Oldřich II of Rosenberg defeated the Taborites near the village of Křeč, which brought an end to their ability to carry out attacks.

zh.s: 克雷奇战役于1435年8月19日发生，是胡斯战争最后一场真正意义上的战斗。此前一年，利帕尼战役终结了波希米亚大部分激进胡斯派势力，但仍有一些团体继续作战。罗森堡的奥德日赫二世在克雷奇村附近击败塔博尔派，终结了他们继续发动袭击的能力。

en.t: Pope Pius II is elected the 211th Pope
en.s: Pope Pius II (Latin: Pius PP. II, Italian: Pio II), born Enea Silvio Bartolomeo Piccolomini (Latin: Aeneas Silvius Bartholomeus; 18 October 1405 – 14 August 1464), was head of the Catholic Church and ruler of the Papal States from 19 August 1458 to his death in 1464. Aeneas Silvius was an author, diplomat, and orator, and private secretary of Antipope Felix V and then the Emperor Frederick III, and then Pope Eugenius IV.

zh.t: 教宗庇护二世当选第211任教宗
zh.s: 教宗庇护二世（拉丁语：Pius PP. II；意大利语：Pio II），本名埃涅阿·西尔维奥·巴托洛梅奥·皮科洛米尼（拉丁语：Aeneas Silvius Bartholomeus；1405年10月18日—1464年8月14日），于1458年8月19日至1464年去世期间担任天主教会领袖和教皇国统治者。埃涅阿·西尔维奥曾是作家、外交官和演说家，先后担任对立教宗斐理五世、皇帝腓特烈三世以及教宗尤金四世的私人秘书。

en.s: Battle of Eflatun Pınar or Battle of Kıreli is a battle fought between the Ottoman Empire and Aq Qoyunlu with the Karamanids. Although Mehmed II did not personally take part in this battle at the tactical level, the entire military strategy, operational maneuvers, and the mobilization of the army to Kütahya were carried out on his orders.

zh.s: 埃夫拉坦帕纳尔战役又称克雷利战役，是奥斯曼帝国与阿克科云鲁及卡拉曼侯国之间的一场战斗。穆罕默德二世虽未亲自参与战术层面的战斗，但整体军事战略、作战机动以及向屈塔希亚调兵均按他的命令执行。

en.s: The Battle of Knockdoe was a battle that took place on 19 August 1504 at Knockdoe, in the Parish of Lackagh (Irish Leacach), County Galway, between two Anglo-Irish lords—Gerald FitzGerald, Earl of Kildare, the Lord Deputy of Ireland, and Ulick Fionn Burke, lord of Clanricarde—along with their respective Irish allies. The cause was a dispute between Maelsechlainn mac Tadhg Ó Cellaigh (Mod. Irish Maoilseachlainn mac Thaidhg Uí Cheallaigh), King of Ui Maine – Mod. Irish Uí Mháine) and Clanricarde.The major contemporary sources for this battle are the Gaelic Irish annals and a sixteenth-century manuscript written in the Pale known as "the Book of Howth".

zh.s: 诺克多战役于1504年8月19日在爱尔兰戈尔韦郡拉卡教区的诺克多发生。交战双方是两位盎格鲁—爱尔兰领主：基尔代尔伯爵、爱尔兰副总督杰拉尔德·菲茨杰拉德，以及克兰里卡德领主乌利克·芬·伯克，双方各自有爱尔兰盟友参战。战事起因是乌伊梅恩国王迈尔谢兰·麦克塔格·奥凯利（现代爱尔兰语：Maoilseachlainn mac Thaidhg Uí Cheallaigh）与克兰里卡德之间的争端。关于这场战役的主要同时代史料包括盖尔爱尔兰编年史，以及一份在帕莱地区写成、名为《豪斯之书》的16世纪手稿。

zh.s: 格沃兹杰茨战役于1531年爆发，是波兰-摩尔达维亚战争的一部分。

en.t: Mary, Queen of Scots, aged 18, returns to Scotland after spending 13 years in France
en.s: Mary, Queen of Scots (8 December 1542 – 8 February 1587), also known as Mary Stuart or Mary I of Scotland, was Queen of Scotland from 14 December 1542 until her forced abdication on 24 July 1567. The only surviving legitimate child of King James V of Scotland, Mary was six days old when her father died, and she inherited the throne.

zh.t: 18岁的苏格兰女王玛丽在法国生活13年后返回苏格兰
zh.s: 苏格兰女王玛丽（1542年12月8日—1587年2月8日），也称玛丽·斯图亚特或苏格兰的玛丽一世，于1542年12月14日至1567年7月24日被迫退位期间担任苏格兰女王。她是苏格兰国王詹姆斯五世唯一存活的婚生子女；父亲去世时她年仅六天大，随后继承王位。

en.s: The siege of Sluis (1604), also known as the Sluis campaign or the Battle of the Oostburg Line, was a series of military actions that took place during the Eighty Years' War and the Anglo–Spanish War from 19 May to 19 August 1604. A States and English army under Prince Maurice of Orange and Horace Vere respectively crossed the Scheldt estuary and advanced on land taking Cadzand, Aardenburg, and IJzendijke in the Spanish Netherlands.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1604年斯勒伊斯围城战也称斯勒伊斯战役或奥斯特堡防线之战，是八十年战争和英西战争期间一系列军事行动的一部分，持续时间为1604年5月19日至8月19日。尼德兰联省共和国和英国联军分别由奥兰治亲王莫里斯和霍勒斯·维尔率领，渡过斯海尔德河口后向内陆推进，夺取了西属尼德兰的卡赞德、阿尔登堡和艾曾代克。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: Eighty Years War: a besieging Dutch and English army led by Maurice of Orange forces the Spanish garrison of Sluis to capitulate
en.s: The Eighty Years' War or Dutch Revolt (c. 1566/1568–1648) was an armed conflict in the Habsburg Netherlands between disparate groups of rebels and the Spanish government. The causes of the war included the Reformation, centralisation, excessive taxation, and the rights and privileges of the Dutch nobility and cities. After the initial stages, Philip II of Spain, the sovereign of the Netherlands, deployed his armies and regained control over most of the rebel-held territories.

zh.t: 八十年战争：奥兰治亲王莫里斯率领围城中的荷英联军，迫使斯勒伊斯的西班牙守军投降
zh.s: 八十年战争又称荷兰起义（约1566／1568—1648年），是哈布斯堡尼德兰境内由不同反叛团体与西班牙政府之间进行的一场武装冲突。战争起因包括宗教改革、中央集权、过重税收，以及荷兰贵族和城市的权利与特权。战争初期过后，尼德兰君主、西班牙国王腓力二世派兵出征，重新控制了叛军占据的大部分地区。

en.s: The Siege of Lingen of 1605 took place between 10 August and 19 August 1605, at Lingen, District of Emsland, Lower Saxony, between Spain and the United Provinces, during the Eighty Years' War. Prince Maurice of Nassau tried to preserve Lingen at all costs. The Dutch garrison led by Captain Maerten Cobben, expecting to be aided by Maurice's army, held out for nine days, but were finally forced to surrender. The siege was part of Spinola's successful campaign of 1605-1606.

zh.s: 林根围城战发生于1605年8月10日至19日，地点在下萨克森州埃姆斯兰地区的林根。八十年战争期间，西班牙与尼德兰联省共和国在此交战。拿骚的莫里斯亲王不惜一切代价试图守住林根。由马尔滕·科本上尉率领的荷兰守军原本期待得到莫里斯军队增援，坚守了9天后最终被迫投降。这场围城战是斯皮诺拉1605至1606年成功战役的一部分。

en.s: The attack on Sousse was launched by a joint Christian armada in 1619 against the Tunisian city of Sousse. The attack ended in Fiasco for the Christians.

zh.s: 1619年，一支基督教联合舰队向突尼斯城市苏塞发动进攻。进攻以基督教一方惨败告终。

en.s: The siege of Grol in 1627 was a battle between the Army of the Dutch Republic, commanded by Frederick Henry, Prince of Orange, and the Spanish-controlled fortified city of Grol (now known as Groenlo), during the Eighty Years War and the Anglo–Spanish War in 1627. The Spanish Army, led by Hendrik van den Bergh, came to relieve Grol but too late.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1627年格罗尔围城战发生在八十年战争和英西战争期间，交战双方是奥兰治亲王腓特烈·亨利指挥的尼德兰联省共和国军队，以及由西班牙控制的格罗尔（今称格罗恩洛）要塞城。亨德里克·范登贝赫率领的西班牙军队前来解围，但为时已晚。

en.s: The Battle of Winwick (also known as the Battle of Red Bank) was fought on 19 August 1648 near the Lancashire village of Winwick between part of a Royalist army under Lieutenant General William Baillie and a Parliamentarian army commanded by Lieutenant General Oliver Cromwell. The Royalists were defeated with all of those who took part in the fighting, their army's entire infantry force, either killed or captured.

zh.s: 温威克战役（又称红岸战役）于1648年8月19日在兰开夏郡温威克村附近打响。交战双方是威廉·贝利中将率领的部分保王军，以及奥利弗·克伦威尔中将指挥的议会军。保王军战败，所有参加战斗的人员——其全体步兵——不是阵亡就是被俘。

en.s: The Battle of Winnington Bridge, often described as the last battle of the English Civil War, took place on 19 August 1659 during Booth's Uprising, a Royalist rebellion in north-west England and Wales. During the battle a Parliamentary army of around 5,000 men under the command of General John Lambert defeated a rebel army of 4,000 men under the command of Sir George Booth.

zh.s: 温宁顿桥战役常被称为英国内战的最后一场战斗，于1659年8月19日在布斯起义期间爆发。布斯起义是保王派在英格兰西北部和威尔士发动的叛乱。战斗中，约翰·兰伯特将军率领约5,000名议会军，击败了乔治·布斯爵士指挥的4,000名叛军。

en.t: Second Anglo-Dutch War: Rear Admiral Robert Holmes leads a raid on the Dutch island of Terschelling, destroying 116 to 160 merchant ships, an act later known as "Holmes's Bonfire"
en.s: The Second Anglo-Dutch War began on 4 March 1665 and concluded with the signing of the Treaty of Breda on 31 July 1667. It was the second in a series of naval wars fought between England and the Dutch Republic and it was driven largely by commercial rivalry, competition over maritime trade, and disputes over overseas colonies and trading posts.

zh.t: 第二次英荷战争：海军少将罗伯特·霍姆斯袭击荷兰泰尔斯海灵岛，摧毁116至160艘商船，此事后来被称为“霍姆斯纵火”
zh.s: 第二次英荷战争于1665年3月4日爆发，1667年7月31日以签署《布雷达条约》结束。这是英格兰与荷兰共和国之间一系列海战中的第二次，主要由商业竞争、海上贸易争夺以及海外殖民地和贸易据点纠纷引发。

en.s: The Battle of Slankamen (also Battle of Szlankamen in some sources) was fought near Slankamen in the Ottoman Sanjak of Syrmia (modern-day Vojvodina region, Serbia) on August 19, 1691, between the Ottoman Empire, and the forces of Austria and states of the Holy Roman Empire as part of the Great Turkish War.

zh.s: 斯兰卡门战役（部分资料拼作Szlankamen）于1691年8月19日在奥斯曼帝国斯雷姆桑贾克的斯兰卡门附近举行，该地区今属塞尔维亚伏伊伏丁那。交战双方是奥斯曼帝国与奥地利及神圣罗马帝国各邦的军队。这场战役是大土耳其战争的一部分。

en.t: Salem witch trials: In Salem, province of Massachusetts Bay, Martha Carrier, George Jacobs Sr., John Proctor, John Willard, and clergyman George Burroughs are executed after being convicted of witchcraft
en.s: The Salem witch trials were a series of hearings and prosecutions of people accused of witchcraft in colonial Massachusetts between February 1692 and May 1693. More than 200 people were accused. Thirty people were found guilty, nineteen of whom were executed by hanging (fourteen women and five men). One other man, Giles Corey, died under torture for refusing to enter a plea, and at least five people died in the disease-ridden jails without trial.

zh.t: 塞勒姆审巫案：在马萨诸塞湾省塞勒姆，玛莎·卡里尔、老乔治·雅各布斯、约翰·普罗克特、约翰·威拉德和牧师乔治·巴勒斯被判施行巫术后处决
zh.s: 塞勒姆审巫案是1692年2月至1693年5月间，马萨诸塞殖民地对被控施行巫术者进行的一系列听证和起诉。超过200人遭到指控，30人被判有罪，其中19人被处以绞刑（14名女性、5名男性）。另一名男子吉尔斯·科里因拒绝答辩而遭酷刑致死；此外，至少有5人在疾病肆虐的监狱中未经审判便死亡。

en.s: The Battle of Falmouth was fought at Falmouth, Maine when the Canadiens and Wabanaki Confederacy attacked the English New Casco Fort. The battle was part of the Northeast Coast Campaign (1703) during Queen Anne's War.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

en.s: The siege of San Sebastián took place in 1719 during the War of the Quadruple Alliance when French forces under the Duke of Berwick successfully laid siege to the Spanish city of San Sebastián close to the French border. Combined with the British capture of Vigo and Pontevedra, this led the Spanish to seek peace terms and the war ended with the agreement of the Treaty of The Hague in 1720.

zh.s: 1719年四国同盟战争期间，贝里克公爵率领的法军成功围攻了靠近法国边境的西班牙城市圣塞巴斯蒂安。英国攻占维戈和蓬特韦德拉，与这场围城战共同促使西班牙寻求和谈。战争于1720年以签署《海牙条约》告终。

en.t: J. S. Bach leads the first performance of Lobe den Herren, den mächtigen König der Ehren, BWV 137, a cantata setting the unchanged text of Neander's hymn
en.s: Johann Sebastian Bach composed the church cantata Lobe den Herren, den mächtigen König der Ehren (Praise the Lord, the mighty King of honor), BWV 137, in Leipzig for the twelfth Sunday after Trinity and led the first performance on 19 August 1725. The chorale cantata is based on the hymn by Joachim Neander, a general song of praise published in 1680.

zh.t: 约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫指挥《赞美主，荣耀的大能君王》（BWV 137）首演，作品沿用尼安德赞美诗原文
zh.s: 约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫在莱比锡创作了教会康塔塔《Lobe den Herren, den mächtigen König der Ehren》（《赞美主，荣耀的大能君王》，BWV 137），供三一主日后第十二主日演出，并于1725年8月19日指挥首演。这部众赞歌康塔塔以约阿希姆·尼安德的赞美诗原文为基础；该诗于1680年出版，是一首通用赞美诗。

en.s: The Battle of Kars (19 August 1745) was the last major engagement of the Ottoman–Persian War. The battle resulted in the complete and utter destruction of the Ottoman army. It was also the last of the great military triumphs of Nader Shah. The battle was fought over a period of ten days in which the first day saw the Ottomans routed from the field, followed by a series of subsequent blockades and pursuits until the final destruction of the Ottoman army.

zh.s: 卡尔斯战役于1745年8月19日爆发，是奥斯曼—波斯战争中的最后一场大型交战。奥斯曼军队在战役中遭到彻底摧毁。这也是纳迪尔沙赫最后一次重大军事胜利。战役持续了10天：第一天奥斯曼军队被逐出战场，随后双方经历一系列围困和追击，最终奥斯曼军队被彻底消灭。

en.s: The Jacobite rising of 1745 was an attempt to regain the British throne for the exiled House of Stuart. The last in a series of Jacobite risings that began in March 1689, it proved to be the end of Jacobitism as a major factor in British politics. The uprising was formally launched by Charles Edward Stuart on 19 August 1745 at Glenfinnan in the Scottish Highlands, with the rebels capturing Edinburgh and winning the Battle of Prestonpans in September.

zh.s: 1745年詹姆斯党起义旨在让流亡的斯图亚特王朝重登英国王位。这是自1689年3月开始的一系列詹姆斯党起义中的最后一次，此后詹姆斯党不再是英国政坛的重要力量。查尔斯·爱德华·斯图亚特于1745年8月19日在苏格兰高地的格伦芬南正式发动起义。叛军随后攻占爱丁堡，并于9月在普雷斯顿潘斯战役中获胜。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The Battle of Lagos took place between a British fleet commanded by Edward Boscawen and a French fleet under Jean-François de La Clue-Sabran over two days in 1759 during the Seven Years' War. They fought south west of the Gulf of Cádiz on 18 August and to the east of the small Portuguese port of Lagos, after which the battle is named, on 19 August.
en.n: Battle of Lagos: Naval battle during the Seven Years' War between Great Britain and France.

zh.s: 七年战争期间，爱德华·博斯科恩率领的英国舰队与让-弗朗索瓦·德·拉克吕-萨布朗率领的法国舰队于1759年交战，战斗持续两天。8月18日，双方在加的斯湾西南交战；8月19日，战斗转至葡萄牙小港拉各斯以东，该港口也因此成为战役名称的由来。
zh.n: 拉各斯海战：七年战争期间英国与法国之间的一场海战。

en.s: The Revolution of 1772, also known as The Bloodless Revolution (Swedish: Revolutionen) or the Coup of Gustav III (Gustav III:s statskupp or older Gustav III:s statsvälvning), was a Swedish coup d'état performed by King Gustav III on 19 August 1772 to introduce a division of power between the King and the Riksdag of the Estates, resulting in the end of the Age of Liberty and the introduction of the Swedish Constitution of 1772, which would strengthen the power of the monarch and the start the absolutist period known as the Gustavian era.

zh.s: 1772年瑞典革命也称“不流血革命”（瑞典语：Revolutionen）或古斯塔夫三世政变（瑞典语：Gustav III:s statskupp，旧称Gustav III:s statsvälvning）。古斯塔夫三世国王于1772年8月19日发动政变，试图在国王与瑞典四等级议会之间划分权力。此举结束了自由时代，并颁布1772年瑞典宪法，加强君主权力，开启了被称为古斯塔夫时代的专制时期。

en.s: The Battle of Paulus Hook was fought on August 19, 1779 between Continental Army and British forces in the American Revolutionary War. The Patriots were led by Major Light Horse Harry Lee, and launched a nighttime raid on the British-controlled fort in what is today downtown Jersey City. They surprised the British, taking 158 prisoners, and withdrew with the approach of daylight. Despite retaining the fort and its cannons, the British lost much of their control over New Jersey. Lee was rewarded by the Second Continental Congress with a gold medal, the only non-general to receive such an award during the war.

zh.s: 保卢斯胡克战役于1779年8月19日在美国独立战争期间打响，交战双方是大陆军和英军。爱国者军由“轻骑兵哈里”李少校率领，夜间突袭了英军控制的堡垒，地点在今天泽西市市中心一带。他们打了英军一个措手不及，俘虏158人，并在天亮临近时撤退。英军虽然保住了堡垒和火炮，却失去了对新泽西州大部分地区的控制。李获第二次大陆会议授予金质奖章，是战争期间唯一获此奖的非将军。

en.s: The Franco-Spanish reconquest of Minorca from the British in February 1782, after the siege of Fort St. Philip lasting over five months, was an important step in the achievement of Spain's aims in its alliance with France against Britain during the American Revolutionary War. The ultimate result was the devolution of the island to Spain in the Treaty of Paris in 1783.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 经过持续五个多月的围城，法西联军于1782年2月从英国手中收复梅诺卡岛。这是西班牙在美国独立战争期间实现其与法国结盟、共同对抗英国的目标的重要一步。最终，1783年《巴黎条约》将该岛归还西班牙。

en.s: The Battle of Blue Licks, fought on August 19, 1782, was one of the last battles of the American Revolutionary War. The battle occurred ten months after Lord Cornwallis's surrender at Yorktown, which had effectively ended the war in the east. On a hill next to the Licking River in what is now Robertson County, Kentucky (then Fayette County, Virginia), a force of 50 Butler's Rangers and 300 Indigenous warriors ambushed and routed 182 Kentucky militia, who were partially led by Daniel Boone, the famed frontiersman.

zh.s: 蓝利克斯战役于1782年8月19日打响，是美国独立战争最后几场战斗之一。康沃利斯勋爵在约克镇投降、实际上结束东部战事10个月后，战役在今肯塔基州罗伯逊县（当时属弗吉尼亚州费耶特县）利金河旁的一座山丘上爆发。50名巴特勒游骑兵和300名原住民战士伏击并击溃了182名肯塔基民兵，其中部分民兵由著名拓荒者丹尼尔·布恩率领。

en.s: The Russo-Turkish War of 1787–1792 involved an unsuccessful attempt by the Ottoman Empire to regain lands lost to the Russian Empire in the course of the previous Russo-Turkish War (1768–1774). It took place concomitantly with the Austro-Turkish War (1788–1791), the Russo-Swedish War (1788–1790), and the Theatre War. During the Russian-Turkish War of 1787–1792, on 25 September 1789, a detachment of the Imperial Russian Army under Alexander Suvorov and Ivan Gudovich took Khadjibey and Yeni Dünya for the Russian Empire.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1787至1792年的俄土战争中，奥斯曼帝国试图收复此前在俄土战争（1768—1774年）中失去的领土，但未能成功。该战争与奥土战争（1788—1791年）、俄瑞战争（1788—1790年）以及剧院战争同时发生。1787至1792年俄土战争期间，1789年9月25日，亚历山大·苏沃洛夫和伊万·古多维奇率领的一支俄罗斯帝国军队分遣队为俄罗斯帝国夺取了哈吉贝伊和新世界。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The Battle of Mahé was a naval engagement of the East Indies theatre of the French Revolutionary Wars, fought on 19 August 1801 in the harbor of Mahé in the Seychelles, a French colony in the Indian Ocean. Since the demise of the French Indian Ocean squadron in 1799, the Royal Navy had maintained dominance in the East Indies, controlling the shipping routes along which trade flowed and allowing the rapid movement of military forces around the theatre.

zh.s: 马埃海战是法国大革命战争东印度战场的一场海战，于1801年8月19日在印度洋法国殖民地塞舌尔的马埃港进行。1799年法国印度洋舰队覆灭后，英国皇家海军一直控制着东印度地区的航运路线和贸易通道，也因此能在该战场迅速调动军队。

en.s: The Battle of Sävar was fought on Saturday, 19 August 1809, between Swedish and Russian forces, during the Finnish War; it was the last pitched battle to be fought in Sweden. After the Russian conquest of eastern Sweden (present-day Finland) in 1808, the Swedish forces retreated to actual Sweden.

zh.s: 塞瓦尔战役于1809年8月19日星期六在芬兰战争期间打响，交战双方是瑞典和俄罗斯军队。这是最后一场发生在瑞典本土的会战。1808年俄罗斯征服瑞典东部（今芬兰）后，瑞典军队撤回瑞典本土。

en.s: The siege of Figueras, which lasted from 10 April to 19 August 1811, saw the Spanish garrison of Sant Ferran Castle (San Fernando Fortress) led by Brigadier General Juan Antonio Martínez defend against an Imperial French force commanded by Marshal Jacques MacDonald and his deputy Louis Baraguey d'Hilliers. Martínez and his men held out much longer than expected but were eventually starved into surrendering the fortress, which was near Figueres.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 菲格拉斯围城战持续于1811年4月10日至8月19日。西班牙圣费兰城堡（圣费尔南多要塞）守军由准将胡安·安东尼奥·马丁内斯率领，抵御雅克·麦克唐纳元帅和副手路易·巴拉盖·迪利耶指挥的法兰西帝国军队。马丁内斯和部下的坚守时间远超预期，但最终因粮尽被迫交出这座靠近菲格雷斯的要塞。

en.s: The Siege of Astorga of 1812 took place between 29 June and 19 August 1812, at Astorga, León, Castile-León, Spain, during the Peninsular War. On 29 June, the Spanish troops of Lieutenant-General Francisco Gómez de Terán y Negrete, Marquess of Portago, started the operations, and laid siege to Astorga. The siege was part of the Allied offensive in the summer of 1812. The Spanish VI Army led by General José María Santocildes, by order of General Francisco Castaños, take the measures necessary for the recovery of Astorga. On 18 August, after a hard resistance, the French garrison surrendered to the Spaniards.

zh.s: 1812年阿斯托加围城战发生于1812年6月29日至8月19日，地点在西班牙卡斯蒂利亚-莱昂自治区莱昂省阿斯托加，属于半岛战争的一部分。6月29日，弗朗西斯科·戈麦斯·德·特兰-内格雷特中将率领的西班牙军队开始行动并围攻阿斯托加。这场围城是1812年夏季盟军攻势的一部分。奉弗朗西斯科·卡斯塔尼奥斯将军之命，何塞·玛丽亚·桑托西尔德斯将军率领的西班牙第六军采取必要措施收复阿斯托加。8月18日，法军守军经过顽强抵抗后向西班牙军队投降。

en.s: USS Constitution vs HMS Guerriere was a battle between an American and British ship during the War of 1812, about 400 miles (640 km) southeast of Halifax, Nova Scotia. It took place on the 19th of August 1812, one month after the war's first engagement between British and American forces. Guerriere was proceeding to Halifax for a refit, having been detached from a squadron which had earlier failed to capture Constitution.

zh.t: 宪法号与格雷尔号海战
zh.s: 宪法号与格雷尔号海战是1812年战争期间美国和英国军舰之间的一场战斗，地点在新斯科舍省哈利法克斯东南约400英里（640公里）处。战斗于1812年8月19日发生，距英美双方在战争中的首次交战一个月。格雷尔号原本正前往哈利法克斯维修，此前它已脱离一支曾试图俘获宪法号但未成功的舰队。

en.s: The Battle of Yaguachi or Battle of Cone was a military confrontation that occurred on 19 August 1821 between Guayaquil independence troops and Grancolombian reinforcements, led by Antonio José de Sucre, against Royalist troops led by Colonel Francisco González. The battle was fought near the city of Yaguachi, current Province of Guayas in Ecuador, and was a victory for the Patriots which ensured the definitive independence of the Free Province of Guayaquil.

zh.s: 亚瓜奇战役又称科内战役，于1821年8月19日爆发。安东尼奥·何塞·苏克雷率领的大哥伦比亚援军与瓜亚基尔独立军并肩作战，对抗弗朗西斯科·冈萨雷斯上校率领的保王军。战斗发生在厄瓜多尔现今瓜亚斯省的亚瓜奇市附近。爱国者军获胜，确保了瓜亚基尔自由省最终独立。

en.s: The Battle of Azcapotzalco, (Spanish: Batalla de Azcapotzalco), was fought on August 19, 1821, in the town of Azcapotzalco, near Mexico City. It was to be one of the last military action of the Mexican War of Independence. The insurgents, commanded by the colonels Anastasio Bustamante and Luis Quintanar, fought the Spanish forces commanded by Manuel de la Concha.

zh.s: 阿斯卡波察尔科战役（西班牙语：Batalla de Azcapotzalco）于1821年8月19日在墨西哥城附近的阿斯卡波察尔科镇打响。这是墨西哥独立战争期间最后几场军事行动之一。叛军由阿纳斯塔西奥·布斯塔曼特上校和路易斯·金塔纳尔上校指挥，与曼努埃尔·德·拉·孔查指挥的西班牙军队交战。

en.s: The Battle of the Barrier (Chinese: 澳門之戰) was fought between British and Chinese forces at the boundary separating Macao from mainland China on 19 August 1840 during the First Opium War. Located in modern-day Portas do Cerco, the Macao Peninsula was connected to Xiangshan Island by a narrow isthmus about 100 m (330 ft) wide and 1.2 km (0.75 mi) long.

zh.s: 关闸之战（中文名：澳门之战）于1840年8月19日第一次鸦片战争期间爆发，交战双方是英国和中国军队，战场位于澳门与中国内地的分界处。如今的关闸位于澳门半岛；澳门半岛通过一条狭窄地峡与香山岛相连，地峡宽约100米（330英尺）、长约1.2公里（0.75英里）。

en.s: The second siege of Szenttamás (now Srbobran, in the South Bačka District, Vojvodina, Serbia) was an attempt of siege during the Hungarian War of Independence of 1848-1849, as a part of the Serb uprising of 1848–49, on 19 August 1848, carried out by the Hungarian Army under the command of Lieutenant General Fülöp Bechtold against the Serbian fortified encampment in Szenttamás and Turia held by the Serb insurgents led by Captain Petar Biga.

zh.t: 第二次森塔马什围攻战
zh.s: 第二次森塔马什围攻战于1848年8月19日发生，是1848—1849年匈牙利独立战争期间的一次围城行动，也是1848—1849年塞尔维亚起义的一部分。菲吕普·贝希托尔德中将率领匈牙利军队，进攻塞尔维亚叛军在森塔马什和图里亚设立的防御营地。叛军由彼得·比加上尉率领。森塔马什现称斯尔博布兰，位于塞尔维亚伏伊伏丁那南巴奇卡区。

en.s: The Grattan massacre, also referred to as the Grattan Fight, was the initial conflict of the First Sioux War, occurring on August 19, 1854, between the United States Army and the Lakota Sioux warriors. This event took place east of Fort Laramie, located in the Nebraska Territory, which is now part of Goshen County, Wyoming.

zh.s: 格拉坦惨案又称格拉坦战斗，是第一次苏族战争的首场冲突，于1854年8月19日在美国陆军与拉科塔苏族战士之间发生。事件发生在拉勒米堡以东；该地当时属内布拉斯加领地，现为怀俄明州戈申县的一部分。

en.s: The Battle of the Leotung was a British victory against an overwhelming fleet of Chinese pirate ships. In 1855 the Royal Navy launched a series of operations into the Gulf of Leotung and surrounding area to suppress piracy, several battles were fought and hundreds of pirates were killed.

zh.s: 辽东海战是英国对一支实力远超英方的中国海盗船队取得的一场胜利。1855年，英国皇家海军在辽东湾及周边地区展开一系列行动以打击海盗，期间发生数场战斗，数百名海盗被杀。

en.s: The 1861 Victorian colonial election was held from 2−19 August 1861 to elect the 3rd Parliament of Victoria. All 78 seats in 49 electorates in the Legislative Assembly were up for election, though four seats were uncontested. There were 24 single-member, 21 two-member and 4 three-member electorates. The liberal ministry led by Richard Heales was returned "with materially increased support", supported by the Protectionist League and the goldfields electorates.

zh.s: 维多利亚殖民地于1861年8月2日至19日举行选举，选出第三届维多利亚议会。立法议会49个选区的78个席位全部改选，其中4席没有对手。24个选区选出1名议员，21个选区选出2名，另有4个选区选出3名。理查德·希尔斯领导的自由派内阁成功连任，获得“明显增加的支持”，并得到保护主义联盟和金矿区选民的支持。

en.s: The Battles of New Ulm, also known as the New Ulm Massacre, were two battles in August 1862 between Dakota men and European settlers and militia in New Ulm, Minnesota early in the Dakota War of 1862. Dakota forces attacked New Ulm on August 19 and again on August 23, destroying much of the town but failing to fully capture it.

zh.s: 新乌尔姆战役又称新乌尔姆惨案，是1862年达科他战争初期发生在明尼苏达州新乌尔姆的两场战斗，交战双方是达科他人、欧洲移民和民兵。达科他军队于8月19日和23日两次进攻新乌尔姆，摧毁了城镇的大部分地区，但未能完全占领该镇。

en.s: The Battle of Guayubín (Spanish: Batalla de Guayubín) was a battle of the Dominican Restoration War that took place on August 19, 1863. Dominican forces attacked Spanish cavalry and a marching column during its movement through the northwest, resulting in scattered skirmishes and a Spanish withdrawal toward Guayubín.

zh.s: 瓜尤宾战役（西班牙语：Batalla de Guayubín）是多米尼加复国战争中的一场战斗，于1863年8月19日发生。多米尼加军队在西班牙骑兵和一支行军纵队行经西北部时发动袭击，引发多场零星交战，西班牙军队随后向瓜尤宾撤退。

en.s: At the end of the Russo-Turkish War during the Congress of Berlin, the Treaty of Berlin was established which in article 25 gave Austria-Hungary the responsibility to occupy and administer the Ottoman provinces of Bosnia and Herzegovina indefinitely while it still stayed under the sovereignty of the Ottoman Empire. A campaign was organized to establish Austro-Hungarian rule in Bosnia and Herzegovina on 29 July 1878 which saw mostly combat against local resistance fighters supported by the Ottoman Empire.

zh.s: 俄土战争结束后，在柏林会议期间签订了《柏林条约》。条约第25条规定，奥匈帝国负责无限期占领并管理奥斯曼帝国的波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那行省，但这些地区仍处于奥斯曼帝国主权之下。1878年7月29日，奥匈帝国组织行动以确立对波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那的统治；战斗主要针对得到奥斯曼帝国支持的当地抵抗力量。

en.s: The Siege of Masbate was fought on August 19, 1898 on Masbate island in the Visayas as a part of the Philippine Revolution. The revolt sparked the beginning of the revolutionary government's involvement in the Visayas. It is also one of the most overlooked conflicts in the Revolution.

zh.s: 马斯巴特围城战于1898年8月19日在维萨亚群岛的马斯巴特岛发生，是菲律宾革命的一部分。这场起义促使革命政府开始介入维萨亚群岛事务，也是这场革命中最少被提及的冲突之一。

en.t: The Transfiguration Uprising breaks out in East Thrace, resulting in the establishment of the Strandzha Commune
en.s: The Ilinden–Preobrazhenie Uprising (Bulgarian: Илинденско-Преображенско въстание, romanized: Ilindensko-Preobrazhensko vastanie), consisting of the Ilinden Uprising (Macedonian: Илинденско востание, romanized: Ilindensko vostanie; Greek: Εξέγερση του Ίλιντεν, romanized: Exégersi tou Ílinden) and Preobrazhenie Uprising, was an organized revolt against the Ottoman Empire from August to October 1903. It was prepared and carried out by the Internal Macedonian-Adrianople Revolutionary Organization, with the support of the Supreme Macedonian-Adrianople Committee, which included mostly Bulgarian military personnel.

zh.t: 东色雷斯爆发圣母升天节起义，随后建立斯特兰贾公社
zh.s: 伊林登—圣母升天节起义（保加利亚语：Илинденско-Преображенско въстание，罗马化：Ilindensko-Preobrazhensko vastanie）包括伊林登起义（马其顿语：Илинденско востание，罗马化：Ilindensko vostanie；希腊语：Εξέγερση του Ίλιντεν，罗马化：Exégersi tou Ílinden）和圣母升天节起义，是1903年8月至10月间反抗奥斯曼帝国的一场有组织的起义。起义由马其顿-阿德里安堡内部革命组织筹备并实施，得到最高马其顿-阿德里安堡委员会支持；该委员会成员大多是保加利亚军人。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Portugal on 19 August 1906, the second that year and the fourth in three years. For the first time in several decades no party won an overall majority, with the Liberal Regenerator Party emerging as the largest party with 65 seats.

zh.s: 葡萄牙于1906年8月19日举行议会选举。这是当年第二次选举，也是三年内第四次。数十年来首次没有政党获得绝对多数，革新自由党以65席成为最大党。

en.s: The Battle of Marrakesh was a central battle in the Hafidiya, in which Abd al-Hafid seized power from his brother Abd al-Aziz, fought outside Marrakesh, Morocco on 19 August 1908. A battalion led by Abd al-Aziz departed from Rabat and was ambushed and defeated on its approach to Marrakesh by forces loyal to Abd al-Hafid.

zh.s: 马拉喀什战役是哈菲迪亚斗争中的关键战役，于1908年8月19日在摩洛哥马拉喀什城外打响。阿卜杜勒·哈菲德在斗争中从兄长阿卜杜勒·阿齐兹手中夺取权力。阿卜杜勒·阿齐兹率领的一个营从拉巴特出发，在接近马拉喀什时遭到阿卜杜勒·哈菲德的支持者伏击并被击败。

en.s: The Battle of Chunuk Bair (Turkish: Conk Bayırı Muharebesi) was a World War I battle fought between the Ottoman defenders and troops of the British Empire over control of the peak in August 1915. The capture of Chunuk Bair, (Turkish: Çanak Bayır Basin Slope, now Conk Bayırı), the secondary peak of the Sari Bair range, was one of the two objectives of the Battle of Sari Bair.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第一次世界大战期间，奥斯曼守军与大英帝国部队于1915年8月为争夺山顶控制权而战，这就是丘努克拜尔战役（土耳其语：Conk Bayırı Muharebesi）。丘努克拜尔（土耳其语意为“盆地坡”，现称Conk Bayırı）是萨里拜尔山脉的次高峰。夺取该地是萨里拜尔战役的两个目标之一。

en.s: The action of the Cockcroft took place on 19 August 1917, during the Third Battle of Ypres on the Western Front in the First World War. At the Battle of Langemarck (16–18 August 1917) an attack on the German 4th Army by the British Fifth Army, the infantry of the 48th (South Midland) Division and the 11th (Northern) Division of XVIII Corps had been stopped well short of their objectives.

zh.s: 科克克罗夫特战斗发生于1917年8月19日，是第一次世界大战西线第三次伊普尔战役的一部分。在8月16日至18日的朗厄马克战役中，英国第五集团军进攻德国第四集团军；第十八军下辖的第48（南米德兰）师和第11（北方）师步兵部队未能推进至目标位置。

en.s: The Tambov Rebellion of 1920–1922 was one of the largest and best-organized peasant rebellions challenging the Bolshevik government during the Russian Civil War. The uprising took place in the territories of the modern Tambov Oblast and part of the Voronezh Oblast, less than 500 kilometres (300 mi) southeast of Moscow.
en.n: The Tambov Rebellion breaks out, in response to the Bolshevik policy of Prodrazvyorstka.

zh.s: 1920年至1922年的坦波夫起义是俄罗斯内战期间规模最大、组织最严密的农民起义之一，反抗布尔什维克政府。起义发生在今坦波夫州及沃罗涅日州部分地区，距莫斯科东南不到500公里（300英里）。
zh.n: 坦波夫起义爆发，以回应布尔什维克的余粮收集政策。

en.s: A referendum on merging the posts of Chancellor and President was held in Germany on 19 August 1934, after the death of President Paul von Hindenburg seventeen days earlier. The German leadership sought to gain approval for Adolf Hitler's assumption of supreme power. The referendum was associated with widespread intimidation of voters, and Hitler used the resultant large "yes" vote to claim public support for his activities as the de facto head of state of Germany. In fact, he had assumed these offices and powers immediately (and illegally) upon von Hindenburg's death and used the referendum to legitimize this move, taking the title Führer und Reichskanzler (Führer and Chancellor).

zh.s: 德国于1934年8月19日举行公投，决定是否合并总理和总统职位。总统保罗·冯·兴登堡去世17天后，德国领导层希望借此获得民众对阿道夫·希特勒掌握最高权力的认可。公投期间，选民受到广泛恐吓。希特勒利用大量“赞成”票，声称公众支持他以德国实际国家元首身份行使权力。实际上，兴登堡去世后，希特勒已立即、非法地接管这些职位和权力；他借公投为此举争取合法性，并称自己为“元首兼帝国总理”（Führer und Reichskanzler）。

en.s: The Soap Box Derby is a youth-oriented gravity racer event founded in 1934 in the United States by Myron Scott (a photojournalist native to Dayton, Ohio), employed by the Dayton Daily News, and preceded by events such as Kid Auto Races at Venice in 1914.
en.n: The very first All-American Soap Box Derby race was held on August 19, 1934, at the same location as the Dayton city-wide race in 1933, on a track that measured .

zh.s: 纸板车大赛是一项面向青少年的重力赛车赛事，由《代顿每日新闻》摄影记者、俄亥俄州代顿本地人迈伦·斯科特于1934年在美国创立。它之前已有类似活动，例如1914年在威尼斯举行的儿童汽车赛。
zh.n: 首届全美纸板车大赛于1934年8月19日举行，地点与1933年代顿市级比赛相同，赛道长度为。

en.s: The Italian invasion of British Somaliland (3–19 August 1940) was part of the East African campaign (1940–1941) in which Italian, Eritrean and Somali forces entered the Somaliland Protectorate and defeated its garrison of British, Commonwealth and colonial forces supported by Somali irregulars. The Italian victory was based on mobility and speed but was hampered by the terrain, rainy weather and British resistance.

zh.t: 意大利入侵英属索马里兰
zh.s: 意大利入侵英属索马里兰（1940年8月3日至19日）是东非战役（1940—1941年）的一部分。意大利、厄立特里亚和索马里部队进入索马里兰保护国，击败由索马里非正规部队支援的英国、英联邦和殖民地守军。意军依靠机动性和速度取胜，但地形、雨季天气和英军抵抗也给行动造成阻碍。

en.t: First flight of the B-25 Mitchell medium bomber
en.s: The North American B-25 Mitchell is a twin-engined medium bomber designed and produced by the American aircraft manufacturer North American Aviation. It was named in honor of Brigadier General William "Billy" Mitchell, a pioneer of US military aviation. The B-25's design can be traced back to the late 1930s, having been designed as the NA-62 (based on the preceding NA-40B) to fulfil a requirement issued by the United States Army Air Corps (USAAC).

zh.t: B-25米切尔中型轰炸机首飞
zh.s: 北美航空B-25米切尔是一种双引擎中型轰炸机，由美国飞机制造商北美航空设计和生产。该机以美国军事航空先驱威廉·“比利”·米切尔准将命名。B-25的设计可追溯到20世纪30年代末；它被设计为NA-62型（以此前的NA-40B为基础），以满足美国陆军航空兵团（USAAC）提出的需求。

en.s: The Tiraspol Agreement (Romanian: Acordul de la Tiraspol; German: Tiraspoler Abkommen) was an agreement between Nazi Germany and Romania signed on 19 August 1941 in the city of Tiraspol (now in Moldova, under Transnistrian control) regarding the Romanian administration of the region of Transnistria, which became the Transnistria Governorate. It fell under the rule of Gheorghe Alexianu, under immediate subordination of Ion Antonescu, the Conducător (leader) of Romania.

zh.s: 蒂拉斯波尔协定（罗马尼亚语：Acordul de la Tiraspol；德语：Tiraspoler Abkommen）是纳粹德国与罗马尼亚于1941年8月19日在蒂拉斯波尔签署的协议，规定由罗马尼亚管理德涅斯特河沿岸地区，该地区后来成为德涅斯特河沿岸省。该省由格奥尔基·亚历克西亚努管辖，并直接隶属罗马尼亚领导人扬·安东内斯库。蒂拉斯波尔现属摩尔多瓦，受德涅斯特河沿岸当局控制。

en.s: The Dieppe Raid, also known as the Battle of Dieppe, Operation Rutter during planning stages, and by its final official code-name Operation Jubilee, was an Allied attack on the German-occupied port of Dieppe during the Second World War. The raid took place on the northern coast of France on 19 August 1942. The assault began at 5:00 a.m., and by 10:50 a.m. the Allied commanders were forced to call a retreat. Over 6,000 infantrymen, predominantly Canadian, were supported by The Calgary Regiment of the 1st Canadian Tank Brigade and a strong force of Royal Navy and smaller Royal Air Force landing contingents.

zh.s: 迪耶普突袭又称迪耶普战役，计划阶段代号为“鲁特行动”，最终正式代号为“朱比利行动”。这是第二次世界大战期间盟军对德国占领下的迪耶普港发动的一次攻击。行动于1942年8月19日在法国北部海岸展开，凌晨5时开始进攻；到10时50分，盟军指挥官被迫下令撤退。超过6,000名步兵（大多为加拿大人）参加行动，由加拿大第1坦克旅的卡尔加里团、规模庞大的英国皇家海军部队以及规模较小的英国皇家空军登陆部队支援。

en.s: The Battle of Kupres (Croatian: Bitka za Kupres) was fought in 1942 during World War II in the Independent State of Croatia, between the forces of the Independent State of Croatia and the Yugoslav Partisans, in and around the town of Kupres in western Bosnia. The Partisans launched three concentrated attacks against the garrison of 1,500 men during the nights of 11/12 August, 14 August, and 19 August.

en.s: The Battle of Bobdubi was a series of actions fought in the Salamaua area of the Territory of New Guinea between Australian and Japanese forces which took place from 22 April to 19 August 1943, during World War II. Part of the Allied advance on Salamaua, the battle was fought in conjunction with several other actions in the region as the Allies attempted to draw Japanese attention away from Lae, where they launched seaborne landings in mid-September 1943 in conjunction with airborne landings around Nadzab.

zh.s: 博布杜比战役是第二次世界大战期间的一系列战斗，澳大利亚和日本军队于1943年4月22日至8月19日在新几内亚领地萨拉莫阿地区交战。这场战役是盟军向萨拉莫阿推进的一部分，并与当地其他行动同时进行。盟军试图分散日军对莱城的注意力，之后于1943年9月中旬在莱城发动海上登陆，并在纳扎布附近实施空降。

en.s: Operation Bagration (/bʌɡrʌtiˈɒn/; Russian: Oперация Багратио́н, Operatsiya Bagration) was the codename for the Soviet 1944 Belorussian Strategic Offensive Operation (Russian: Белорусская наступательная операция «Багратион», Belorusskaya nastupatelnaya Operatsiya Bagration) during World War II, which cleared German forces from eastern Poland between 22 June and 19 August 1944.The operation was named after 18th–19th century Georgian Prince Pyotr Bagration, general of the Imperial Russian Army who was mortally wounded at the Battle of Borodino. The operation resulted in the almost complete destruction of Army Group Centre, which lost all of the Fourth Army and most of the Third Panzer and Ninth Armies.

zh.s: 巴格拉季昂行动（/bʌɡrʌtiˈɒn/；俄语：Операция Багратион，Operatsiya Bagration）是苏联1944年白俄罗斯战略进攻行动的代号（俄语：Белорусская наступательная операция «Багратион»，Belorusskaya nastupatelnaya Operatsiya Bagration）。这是第二次世界大战期间的一场行动，1944年6月22日至8月19日间将德军从波兰东部赶走。行动以18至19世纪的格鲁吉亚亲王彼得·巴格拉季昂命名，他是俄罗斯帝国军队将领，在博罗季诺战役中受致命伤。此次行动几乎彻底摧毁了中央集团军群，其第四集团军全军覆没，第三装甲集团军和第九集团军也损失惨重。

en.s: The Liberation of Paris (French: Libération de Paris) was a battle that took place during World War II from 19 August 1944 until the German garrison surrendered the French capital on 25 August 1944. Paris had been occupied by Nazi Germany since the signing of the Armistice of 22 June 1940, after which the Wehrmacht occupied northern and western France.

zh.s: 巴黎解放（法语：Libération de Paris）是第二次世界大战期间的一场战役，从1944年8月19日持续到8月25日德军守军投降。自1940年6月22日停战协定签署后，巴黎一直被纳粹德国占领；此后，德国国防军占领了法国北部和西部。

en.s: Battle of Nezbudská Lúčka was a clash in which a group of SNB members defended gamekeeper's lodge near Nezbudská Lúčka against larger forces of UPA. Eventually, reinforcements arrived for the defenders and the UPA retreated.

zh.t: 涅兹布德斯卡卢奇卡战役
zh.s: 在涅兹布德斯卡卢奇卡战役中，一队国家安全卫队（SNB）成员守卫涅兹布德斯卡卢奇卡附近的一处护林员小屋，抵挡人数更多的乌克兰起义军（UPA）。最终守军援军赶到，UPA撤退。

en.s: The 1951 All-Ireland Senior Camogie Championship Final was the twentieth All-Ireland Final and the deciding match of the 1951 All-Ireland Senior Camogie Championship, an inter-county camogie tournament for the top teams in Ireland. Dublin rushed into a 4–3 to 0–1 lead within twelve minutes, and never looked worried. Sophie Brack was their top scorer with 4–2, while Eileen Burke scored two goals.

zh.t: 1951年全爱尔兰高级卡莫吉锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 1951年全爱尔兰高级卡莫吉锦标赛决赛是该项跨郡赛事的第20届决赛，也是1951年锦标赛的冠军决胜场。都柏林队在12分钟内迅速以4比3领先1比0，并始终占据优势。索菲·布拉克为球队攻入4球2分，艾琳·伯克攻入两球。

en.s: The 1953 Iranian coup d'état, known in Iran as the 28 Mordad coup (Persian: کودتای ۲۸ مرداد‎‎), was the overthrow of the Prime Minister Mohammad Mosaddegh in favour of strengthening the monarchical rule of Mohammad Reza Pahlavi on 19 August 1953, orchestrated by the United Kingdom (under the name "Operation Boot") and the United States (under the name TPAJAX Project, or Operation Ajax). Mossadegh had sought to audit the documents of the Anglo-Iranian Oil Company (AIOC), a British corporation (now part of BP) and to limit the company's control over Iranian petroleum reserves.

zh.s: 1953年伊朗政变在伊朗称为“28莫尔达德政变”（波斯语：کودتای ۲۸ مرداد），于1953年8月19日推翻首相穆罕默德·摩萨台，以加强穆罕默德·礼萨·巴列维的君主统治。政变由英国（行动代号“靴子行动”）和美国（代号TPAJAX计划或“阿贾克斯行动”）策划。此前，摩萨台曾试图审查英伊石油公司（AIOC，英国公司，现为英国石油公司的一部分）的文件，并限制该公司对伊朗石油储备的控制。

en.s: Hurricane Diane was the first Atlantic hurricane to cause more than an estimated $1 billion in damage ($12 billion in 2025), including direct costs and the loss of business and personal revenue. It formed on August 7 from a tropical wave between the Lesser Antilles and Cape Verde. Diane initially moved west-northwestward with little change in its intensity, but began to strengthen rapidly after turning to the north-northeast.
en.n: In the Northeast United States, severe flooding caused by Hurricane Diane, claims 200 lives.

zh.s: 飓风黛安是大西洋上首个造成估计超过10亿美元损失的飓风（按2025年币值约为120亿美元），损失包括直接成本以及企业和个人收入损失。它于8月7日在小安的列斯群岛和佛得角之间由一股热带波发展而成。黛安起初向西北偏西移动，强度变化不大；转向东北偏北后开始迅速增强。
zh.n: 美国东北部：飓风黛安引发严重洪灾，造成200人死亡。

en.s: General elections were held in the Federation of Malaya on Wednesday, 19 August 1959 for members of the first Parliament of the Federation of Malaya, the first parliamentary election in Malaya. It was the third national-wide election held in Malaya since the end of World War II. This would be the last Malayan election, before the country was superseded by Malaysia with three other states of Sarawak, Sabah and Singapore in 1963.

zh.s: 马来亚联合邦于1959年8月19日星期三举行大选，选出首届马来亚联合邦议会成员，也是马来亚首次议会选举。这是第二次世界大战结束后马来亚举行的第三次全国选举。1963年马来亚被马来西亚取代，后者还包括砂拉越、沙巴和新加坡；这是最后一次以马来亚名义举行的选举。

en.t: Sputnik program: Korabl-Sputnik 2: The Soviet Union launches the satellite with the dogs Belka and Strelka, 40 mice, two rats and a variety of plants
en.s: Korabl-Sputnik 2 (Russian: Корабль-Спутник 2, lit. 'Ship-Satellite 2'), also known as Sputnik 5 in the West, was a Soviet artificial satellite, and the third test flight of the Vostok spacecraft. It was the first spaceflight to send animals into orbit and return them safely back to Earth, including two Soviet space dogs, Belka and Strelka.

zh.t: 人造卫星计划：宇宙飞船2号发射，搭载小狗别尔卡和斯特列尔卡、40只老鼠、两只大鼠及多种植物
zh.s: 宇宙飞船2号也称西方所称的“斯普特尼克5号”，是苏联人造卫星，也是东方号飞船的第三次试飞。它首次将动物送入轨道并安全带回地球，其中包括苏联太空犬别尔卡和斯特列尔卡。

en.t: Syncom 3, the first geostationary communication satellite, is launched. Two months later, it would enable live coverage of the 1964 Summer Olympics
en.s: Syncom (for "synchronous communication satellite") started as a 1961 NASA program for active geosynchronous communication satellites, all of which were developed and manufactured by the Space and Communications division of Hughes Aircraft Company (now the Boeing Satellite Development Center). Syncom 2, launched in 1963, was the world's first geosynchronous communications satellite. Syncom 3, launched in 1964, was the world's first geostationary satellite.

zh.t: 全球首颗地球静止通信卫星Syncom 3发射升空；两个月后，它将为1964年夏季奥运会提供现场直播
zh.s: Syncom（“同步通信卫星”的简称）始于美国国家航空航天局（NASA）1961年的一项计划，旨在研发有源地球同步通信卫星。这些卫星均由休斯飞机公司的太空与通信部门（现为波音卫星开发中心）研发和制造。1963年发射的Syncom 2是世界上第一颗地球同步通信卫星；1964年发射的Syncom 3则是世界上第一颗地球静止卫星。

en.s: The Pasir Mas Hulu by-election was a parliamentary by-election that was held on 19 August 1967 in the state of Kelantan, Malaysia. The Pasir Mas Hulu seat fell vacant following its PMIP MP Abdul Samad Gul Ahmad Mianji being axed to death on 3 July 1967. He won the seat in 1964 Malaysian general election with a majority of 4,361 votes.

zh.s: 马来西亚吉兰丹州巴西马胡鲁选区于1967年8月19日举行国会补选。该选区的泛马伊斯兰党（PMIP）议员阿卜杜勒·萨马德·古尔·艾哈迈德·米安吉于1967年7月3日被斧头砍死，席位因此出缺。他在1964年马来西亚大选中以4,361票的多数当选。

zh.s: 本文列出了1976年美国总统选举中可能获得共和党副总统候选人提名的人选。在1976年共和党全国代表大会上，时任总统杰拉尔德·福特险胜前加利福尼亚州州长罗纳德·里根，获得总统候选人提名。

en.s: On 19 August 1978 in the Cinema Rex fire (Persian: آتش سوزی سینما رکس‎‎), the Cinema Rex in Abadan, Iran, was set ablaze, killing at least 470 individuals. The event started when men barred the doors and doused the place with gasoline before setting it alight. The ruling government of Iran reported that Islamic militants set the fire, while the anti-Shah protesters blamed the intelligence service of the nation, SAVAK for setting the fire. Later it was disclosed that Islamic militants set the Cinema Rex fire.

zh.s: 1978年8月19日，伊朗阿巴丹的雷克斯电影院遭纵火，至少470人死亡。纵火者先堵住出口、在影院内浇洒汽油，再点火。伊朗政府称纵火者是伊斯兰武装分子，反国王示威者则指责国家情报机构萨瓦克（SAVAK）。后来披露，雷克斯电影院火灾确由伊斯兰武装分子制造。

en.s: Saudia Flight 163 was a scheduled passenger flight of Saudia that caught fire after takeoff from Riyadh International Airport (now the Riyadh Air Base) on a flight to Jeddah, Saudi Arabia on Tuesday, 19 August 1980. All 287 passengers and 14 crew on board the Lockheed L-1011-200 TriStar, registration HZ-AHK, died after the aircraft made an emergency landing back at the Riyadh airport.

zh.s: 1980年8月19日星期二，沙特航空163号定期客运航班从利雅得国际机场（现为利雅得空军基地）起飞，前往沙特阿拉伯吉达，起飞后机舱起火。洛克希德L-1011-200“三星”客机（注册号HZ-AHK）紧急返回利雅得机场并降落，但机上287名乘客和14名机组人员全部遇难。

en.s: The Otłoczyn railway accident (Polish: Katastrofa kolejowa pod Otłoczynem) was a train wreck which occurred on August 19, 1980, near the village of Otłoczyn (Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship, northern Poland). At 4:30 a.m., a freight train collided with a passenger train which ran from Torun Main Station to Łódź Kaliska. As a result, 65 people were killed, and 64 injured, out of which an additional two later died (bringing the total number of dead to 67).

zh.s: 奥特沃琴铁路事故（波兰语：Katastrofa kolejowa pod Otłoczynem）于1980年8月19日发生在波兰北部库亚维—滨海省奥特沃琴村附近。凌晨4时30分，一列货运列车与一列从托伦总站开往罗兹卡利斯卡站的客运列车相撞。事故造成65人死亡、64人受伤，其中两名伤者后来也死亡，死亡总数因此达到67人。

en.s: In the first Gulf of Sidra incident, 19 August 1981, two Libyan Air Force Sukhoi Su-22M3 fighters fired upon two United States Navy Grumman F-14A Tomcats and were subsequently shot down off the Libyan coast, by AIM-9L Sidewinder missiles. The US Navy records that both Libyan pilots ejected and were safely recovered, but one F-14 pilot reported seeing one Su-22 parachute failing to open.

zh.s: 1981年8月19日，利比亚空军两架苏霍伊Su-22M3战斗机向美国海军两架格鲁曼F-14A“雄猫”战斗机开火，随后在利比亚海岸附近被响尾蛇AIM-9L导弹击落。美国海军记录称，两名利比亚飞行员均弹射逃生并被安全救回；但一名F-14飞行员报告说，他看到一架Su-22的降落伞没有打开。

en.s: The 37th Locarno Film Festival was held from 10 to 19 August 1984 in Locarno, Switzerland. For the first time in the history of the festival, the President of the Swiss Confederation, leader of Switzerland, attended the festival. Other notable attendees included writer Patricia Highsmith, actor John Hurt and ambassadors from Italy and India. This was considered the highest attended Locarno festival to date, with an unofficial estimate of 50,000 attendees.

zh.s: 第37届洛迦诺电影节于1984年8月10日至19日在瑞士洛迦诺举行。瑞士联邦主席（即瑞士国家元首）首次出席该电影节。其他知名出席者包括作家帕特里夏·海史密斯、演员约翰·赫特，以及意大利和印度大使。这届电影节被认为是当时观众最多的一届，非正式估计有50,000人参加。

en.s: The Hungerford massacre was a series of random shootings in Hungerford, Berkshire, on 19 August 1987, when Michael Robert Ryan, an unemployed part-time antique dealer and handyman, fatally shot 16 people, before committing suicide. The shootings, committed using a handgun and two semi-automatic rifles, occurred at several locations, including a school he had once attended. A police officer died in the incident, and many people were injured. Fifteen other people were also shot but survived. No firm motive for the killings has ever been established. It remains one of the worst firearms atrocities in UK history.

zh.s: 1987年8月19日，伯克郡亨格福德发生一连串随机枪击事件。失业的兼职古董商和杂工迈克尔·罗伯特·瑞安枪杀16人后自杀。他使用一把手枪和两支半自动步枪，在多个地点开枪，其中包括他曾就读的学校。一名警察在事件中死亡，另有多人受伤；还有15人中枪后幸存。枪击动机至今未能确定。这仍是英国历史上最严重的枪击惨案之一。

en.s: A by-election for the seat of Wanguri in the Northern Territory Legislative Assembly was held on 19 August 1989. The by-election was triggered by the resignation of Country Liberal Party (CLP) Cabinet Minister Don Dale. The seat had been held by Dale since its creation in 1983.

en.s: The 1992 Indian vice presidential election was held on 19 August 1992 to elect the vice president of India. K. R. Narayanan defeated Joginder Singh to become ninth vice president of India. Out of 701 valid votes, Narayanan received 700 votes, while Singh secured only one vote. At the time of the election, VP office was vacant since the incumbent, Shankar Dayal Sharma, had already inaugurated as President following his victory in the presidential election.

zh.s: 印度于1992年8月19日举行副总统选举。K·R·纳拉亚南击败乔金德·辛格，当选印度第9任副总统。在701张有效选票中，纳拉亚南获得700票，辛格仅获1票。时任副总统尚卡尔·达亚尔·夏尔马赢得总统选举后已宣誓就任总统，因此副总统职位在此次选举时空缺。

en.s: Operation "Lukavac '93" (Serbo-Croatian: Operacija "Lukavac '93", Операција "Лукавац '93") was carried out by the Army of Republika Srpska (VRS), commanded by Lieutenant colonel general Ratko Mladić, against the Army of the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina (ARBiH) during the Bosnian War. Their objectives were to create a direct link between the Bosnian Serb-held Herzegovina region and the rest of Republika Srpska and cut the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina supply route to Goražde.

zh.s: 波斯尼亚战争期间，拉特科·姆拉迪奇中将指挥塞族共和国军（VRS）对波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那共和国军（ARBiH）发动“卢卡瓦茨93”行动（塞尔维亚-克罗地亚语：Operacija "Lukavac '93"，Операција "Лукавац '93"）。行动目标是在波斯尼亚塞族控制的黑塞哥维那地区与塞族共和国其他地区之间建立直接通道，并切断波黑共和国通往戈拉日代的补给路线。

en.s: The 2001 SummerSlam was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF, now WWE). It was the 14th annual SummerSlam and took place on August 19, 2001, at the Compaq Center at San Jose in San Jose, California. This was the last SummerSlam held before the introduction of the brand extension in March 2002 and the last promoted under the WWF name, as the promotion was renamed to World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE) in May 2002.

zh.s: 2001年夏日狂潮是世界摔角联盟（WWF，现为WWE）制作的职业摔角按次付费赛事。这是第14届年度夏日狂潮，于2001年8月19日在加利福尼亚州圣何塞的康柏中心举行。这是2002年3月引入品牌划分前的最后一届夏日狂潮，也是该赛事以WWF名义举办的最后一届；该公司于2002年5月更名为世界摔角娱乐（WWE）。

en.t: K-1 Andy Memorial 2001 Japan GP Final
en.s: K-1 Andy Memorial 2001 Japan GP Final was a martial arts event promoted by the K-1 organization, named in honour of K-1 legend Andy Hug who had died the previous year. It was an elimination tournament involving eight fighters based in Japan, with all bouts being fought under K-1 Rules (100 kg/156-220 lbs) and the winner qualifying for the K-1 World Grand Prix 2001. Six of these fighters had qualified via the earlier K-1 Survival 2001 event while holder Musashi had qualified as last years winner and long time Tokyo resident Nicholas Pettas was a foreign invitee. As well as tournament bouts there were a number of local and international bouts, including special 'Andy Memorial Matches', with matches fought under either K-1 or MMA Rules. In total there were twenty two fighters at the event, representing nine countries. The tournament champion was Nicholas Pettas who defeated Musashi in the final by extra round unanimous decision. As a result of the tournament Nicholas Pettas would qualify for the K-1 World Grand Prix 2001. The event was held at the Saitama Super Arena, in Saitama, Japan on Sunday, August 19, 2001.

zh.t: K-1 Andy Memorial 2001 Japan GP Final
zh.s: K-1 Andy Memorial 2001 Japan GP Final是K-1组织主办的一场格斗赛事，以前一年去世的K-1传奇选手安迪·哈格命名。赛事采用淘汰赛制，有8名常驻日本的选手参赛，所有比赛均按K-1规则进行（100公斤／156—220磅），冠军将获得2001年K-1世界大奖赛的参赛资格。其中6名选手通过此前的K-1 Survival 2001赛事获得资格；卫冕冠军武藏则凭借上一届冠军身份获得资格，长期居住东京的尼古拉斯·佩塔斯是受邀的外国选手。除锦标赛对阵外，赛事还安排了多场国内和国际比赛，包括特别的“安迪纪念赛”，分别采用K-1或综合格斗规则。全场共有22名选手，代表9个国家。锦标赛冠军尼古拉斯·佩塔斯在决赛加赛一轮后，以一致判定击败武藏。他因此获得2001年K-1世界大奖赛的参赛资格。赛事于2001年8月19日星期日在日本埼玉县的埼玉超级竞技场举行。

en.s: The 2001 Supercoppa Italiana was a match played by 2000–01 Serie A winners Roma and 2000–01 Coppa Italia winners Fiorentina. The match took place on 19 August 2001 in Stadio Olimpico, Rome and resulted in a 3–0 victory for Roma. The goals were scored by Vincent Candela, Vincenzo Montella and Francesco Totti. It was the first time that Roma won this trophy.

zh.s: 2001年意大利超级杯由2000—01赛季意甲冠军罗马对阵意大利杯冠军佛罗伦萨，于2001年8月19日在罗马奥林匹克体育场举行。罗马以3比0获胜，进球者为文森特·坎德拉、文森佐·蒙特拉和弗朗切斯科·托蒂。这是罗马首次赢得该项赛事冠军。

en.s: On 19 August 2002, a group of Chechen separatists armed with a man-portable air-defense system brought down a Russian Mil Mi-26 helicopter in a minefield, which resulted in the death of 127 Russian soldiers in the greatest loss of life in the history of helicopter aviation. It is also the deadliest aviation disaster ever suffered by the Russian Armed Forces.

zh.t: 2002年汉卡拉米-26直升机坠毁事件
zh.s: 2002年8月19日，一伙车臣分离主义者使用便携式防空系统击落一架俄罗斯米尔米-26直升机。直升机坠入雷区，导致127名俄罗斯士兵死亡。这是直升机航空史上死亡人数最多的事故，也是俄罗斯武装部队遭遇过的最严重航空灾难。

en.s: The Canal Hotel Bombing in Baghdad, Iraq, in the afternoon of August 19, 2003, killed at least 22 people, including the United Nations' Special Representative in Iraq Sérgio Vieira de Mello, and wounded over 100. The blast targeted the United Nations Assistance Mission in Iraq created just 5 days earlier. (The United Nations had used the hotel as its headquarters in Iraq since the early 1990s.) That 19 August bombing resulted in the withdrawal within weeks of most of the 600 UN staff members from Iraq. These events were to have a profound and lasting impact on the UN's security practices globally.

zh.s: 2003年8月19日下午，伊拉克巴格达的运河酒店遭到爆炸袭击，至少22人死亡、100多人受伤，死者包括联合国伊拉克特别代表塞尔吉奥·维埃拉·德梅洛。袭击目标是刚成立5天的联合国伊拉克援助团。（联合国自20世纪90年代初起就将该酒店用作驻伊拉克总部。）8月19日的爆炸发生后，600名联合国驻伊人员中大多数在数周内撤离伊拉克。这些事件对联合国全球安全工作产生了深远而持久的影响。

en.s: The Shmuel HaNavi bus bombing was the suicide bombing of a crowded public bus (Egged bus 2) in the Shmuel HaNavi quarter in Jerusalem, Israel, on August 19, 2003. Twenty-four people were killed and over 130 wounded. Many of the victims were children, some of them infants. The Islamist militant group Hamas claimed responsibility for the attack.

zh.t: 什穆埃尔·哈纳维街公交车爆炸案
zh.s: 2003年8月19日，以色列耶路撒冷什穆埃尔·哈纳维街区一辆载满乘客的公交车（Egged 2路）遭自杀式爆炸袭击。24人死亡，130多人受伤。许多受害者是儿童，其中一些还是婴儿。伊斯兰主义武装组织哈马斯宣称对此次袭击负责。

en.s: Ma Ying-jeou (Chinese: 馬英九; pinyin: Mǎ Yīngjiǔ; Ma-ING-gee-oh; born 13 July 1950) is a Taiwanese politician, lawyer, and legal scholar who served as the sixth president of the Republic of China from 2008 to 2016. A member of the Kuomintang (KMT), he was previously the mayor of Taipei from 1998 to 2006 and the chairman of the Kuomintang for two terms (2005–2007; 2009–2014).

zh.s: 马英九（中文：馬英九；拼音：Mǎ Yīngjiǔ；发音：Ma-ING-gee-oh；生于1950年7月13日）是台湾政治家、律师和法学学者，2008年至2016年担任中华民国第六任总统。他是中国国民党（KMT）成员，此前曾于1998年至2006年担任台北市市长，并两度担任国民党主席（2005—2007年、2009—2014年）。

en.s: The 2006 Albanian Supercup is the 13th edition of the Albanian Supercup since its establishment in 1989. The match was contested between the Albanian Cup 2006 winners KF Tirana and the 2005–06 Albanian Superliga champions KS Elbasani. Tirana won 2-0.

en.s: The 2006 Supertaça Cândido de Oliveira was the 28th edition of the Supertaça Cândido de Oliveira, the annual Portuguese football season-opening match contested by the winners of the previous season's top league and cup competitions (or cup runner-up in case the league- and cup-winning club is the same). en.s: Indirect Senate elections were held in Senegal on 19 August 2007. Over 13,000 MPs, local and municipal councillors were eligible to vote in this election, in which 35 of the Senate's 100 members were chosen across the country's 35 districts; President Abdoulaye Wade nominated the other 65 members. Unlike other elections held in Senegal since 2000, the Senegalese Democratic Party (PDS) of President Wade did not take part in the election as part of the Sopi Coalition, but instead ran independently. The PDS received 8,177 of the 9,624 valid votes, a majority of 85%, and won all but one of the seats.

zh.s: 塞内加尔于2007年8月19日举行间接参议院选举。超过13,000名议员、地方和市镇议员有资格投票。全国35个选区选出参议院100名成员中的35人，其余65人由总统阿卜杜拉耶·瓦德提名。与塞内加尔2000年以来的其他选举不同，瓦德所属的塞内加尔民主党（PDS）没有加入索皮联盟参选，而是单独参选。PDS获得9,624张有效票中的8,177张，得票率为85%，拿下除一个席位外的所有席位。

en.s: The 2007 Supercoppa Italiana was a match contested by 2006–07 Serie A winners Inter Milan and 2006–07 Coppa Italia winners Roma. The match took place on 19 August 2007 in San Siro, Milan, and resulted in a 1–0 victory for Roma. en.s: The 19 August 2009 Baghdad bombings were three coordinated car bomb attacks and a number of mortar strikes in the Iraqi capital, Baghdad. The explosives went off simultaneously across the capital at approximately 10:45 in the morning, killing at least 101 and wounding at least 565, making it the deadliest attack since the 14 August 2007 Yazidi communities bombings in northern Iraq which killed almost 800 people.

zh.s: 2009年8月19日，伊拉克首都巴格达发生三起协调实施的汽车炸弹袭击和多起迫击炮袭击。爆炸物于上午约10时45分在城内多处同时爆炸，至少101人死亡、至少565人受伤。这是自2007年8月14日伊拉克北部雅兹迪社区爆炸案以来最致命的袭击；后者造成近800人死亡。

en.s: The 2012 Albanian Supercup is the 19th edition of the Albanian Supercup since its establishment in 1989. The match was contested between the 2011–12 Albanian Cup winners KF Tirana and the 2011–12 Albanian Superliga champions Skënderbeu Korçë. en.s: The Dhamara Ghat train accident occurred on 19 August 2013 when the Saharsa Patna Rajya Rani Express train struck a large group of people at the Dhamara Ghat railway station in the Indian state of Bihar. At least 28 people were killed and 24 injured. The victims were mostly Hindu pilgrims returning from prayers at the nearby Katyayani temple.

en.s: The 2013 Latakia offensive (called The Descendants of Aisha, Mother of the Believers by Salafi jihadists, and the Operation Liberation of the Coast by the Free Syrian Army and its supporters) was a campaign during the Syrian Civil War launched by rebel groups led by Salafi jihadists in the Latakia Governorate. en.s: The 2017 Ipswich mayoral by-election was held on 19 August 2017 to elect the mayor of Ipswich, a local government area in Queensland, Australia.
